Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt\"}", "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_characters\":300,\"overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
